page_reviews.description: Adventure-story exclusivity
page_reviews.reason: The source uses the statement that everyone loves adventure stories; its exclusive claims are independently rejected.

page_reviews.description: Growth in air travel
page_reviews.reason: Greater ability to travel is relevant; status-symbol claim is unsupported.

page_reviews.description: A-grade mathematics performance
page_reviews.reason: Good conceptual understanding is relevant; never facing difficulty is unsupported.

page_reviews.description: Bike lanes and eco-friendly commuting
page_reviews.reason: Universal immediate cycling is exaggerated; sustainable transport is relevant to the stated policy.

page_reviews.description: Tourist-bus safety warning
page_reviews.reason: Risk of leaning outside supports the warning; passenger attention is an unsupported prediction.

page_reviews.description: Equal education for sons and daughters
page_reviews.reason: The intelligence comparison is unsupported; equal participation is a relevant practical reason.

page_reviews.description: More than one wicketkeeper
page_reviews.reason: Injury backup is a practical contingency; balance disruption is asserted without support.

page_reviews.description: A mother’s warning to a child
page_reviews.reason: The warning relies on its intended deterrent effect; the claim about all children is unsupported.

page_reviews.description: IPL spending and match-fixing claims
page_reviews.reason: Waste is a value judgement; match-fixing is not established by the statement.

page_reviews.description: Reshma’s birthday is in winter
page_reviews.reason: Neither a particular month nor country follows from the statement.

page_reviews.description: Whether plastic bags should be banned
page_reviews.reason: The counterargument about carrying bags lacks enough context to assess practical impact; the opposing arguments are not uniquely classifiable.

page_reviews.description: Complaint about inaccurate globes
page_reviews.reason: A manufacturer complaint addresses the stated inaccurate product; an unrelated government apology does not.

page_reviews.description: Manufacturers facing a power shortage
page_reviews.reason: The proposed action ‘take steps’ is too vague to assess as a concrete, feasible course of action.

page_reviews.description: Introducing computer education in schools
page_reviews.reason: School-wide instructions and teacher training are both relevant implementation measures.

page_reviews.description: Private schools exceed prescribed fee limits
page_reviews.reason: Enforcement addresses violations; shutting all schools is disproportionate.

page_reviews.description: Curriculum has not kept pace with changes
page_reviews.reason: Periodic curriculum review and a more flexible system address both concerns.

page_reviews.description: Voltage fluctuations damage appliances
page_reviews.reason: Electrical inspection and surge protection address the cause; replacing all appliances is excessive.

page_reviews.description: No rain and farmers’ hardship
page_reviews.reason: The stated consequence relies on rainfall being important to farming and to most farmers’ conditions.

page_reviews.description: Crime rate decreased over a year
page_reviews.reason: The change does not establish its cause or citizens’ perception of safety.

page_reviews.description: New employee training programme
page_reviews.reason: The implementation alone does not establish the programme’s purpose or assumed mechanism.

page_reviews.description: Note exchange without a request slip
page_reviews.reason: The slip exception is explicit; a withdrawal limit is not stated.

page_reviews.description: Education quality and funding statements
page_reviews.reason: The relationship between funding and future quality is not stated; the source does not establish either conclusion.

page_reviews.description: 50% pass rate in a class of 90
page_reviews.reason: Half of 90 is 45; the remaining 45 are not 50 failures.

page_reviews.description: Thanjavur called the rice bowl
page_reviews.reason: The proposed conclusions depend on interpreting a figurative label and outside geographic/crop knowledge.

page_reviews.description: Advice to drink coffee twice daily
page_reviews.reason: Advice alone does not establish health benefits or a comparison with tea.

page_reviews.description: Kanish is happy with a gift
page_reviews.reason: The proposed explanation is disjunctive and not necessary; the birthday claim is unrelated.

page_reviews.description: Today is a working day and Mondays are working days
page_reviews.reason: The converse and the exclusivity claim are both unsupported.

page_reviews.description: 200 runs over two matches
page_reviews.reason: The total does not establish how the runs were divided.
